t: Retry an HTTP 429 as a throttling error in standard and adaptive modes when the error code does not match a modeled error.

The standard retry mode is now the default. It uses 3 attempts (4 for DynamoDB), 50 ms base backoff for transient errors (25 ms for DynamoDB) and 1 s for throttling errors, and no longer reads the ``AWS_NEW_RETRIES_2026`` environment variable.

Fixed a KeyError raised by the handler that adds the amz-sdk-invocation-id header when a request-created handler ran on a request that was not sent through the endpoint, such as a request built directly in a test.
Include the resolved max attempts in the ``amz-sdk-request`` header on the initial attempt
Fix backoff calculation for truncated binary exponential backoff (`#3178 <https://github.com/boto/botocore/issues/3178>`__)
Add support for retry modes, including ``standard`` and ``adaptive`` modes (`#1972 <https://github.com/boto/botocore/issues/1972>`__)
Add ability to configure the maximum amount of retry attempts a client call can make. (`#1260 <https://github.com/boto/botocore/pull/1260>`__)
